title: Best Time to Visit Tanzania 2026: Month-by-Month Safari Guide
meta_title: Best Time to Visit Tanzania 2026 | Dry Season, Migration & Beach
meta_description: Best months for a Tanzania safari: dry season wildlife, Great Migration calendar, green season value, Kilimanjaro & Zanzibar timing. Plan with Tanzania Safari Magic in Arusha.
excerpt: Month-by-month Tanzania safari timing — dry vs green season, migration highlights, park picks, crowds, costs, Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar — from Our Team in Arusha.

faqs.q: What is the best overall month for a Tanzania safari?
faqs.a: June–October delivers classic dry-season viewing and (in peak weeks) Mara River migration drama. January–March is outstanding for southern Serengeti calving. “Best” depends on whether you prioritise crossings, calves, greener landscapes, or value.

faqs.q: Is the rainy season a bad time to visit?
faqs.a: Not always. Short rains and long-rain shoulders can mean lush scenery, fewer vehicles, and softer lodge rates. Some roads get tougher and migration herds shift — Our Team designs routes that still work.

faqs.q: When should I go for the Great Migration?
faqs.a: January–March for calving (south/Ndutu); roughly May–June for Grumeti/Western Corridor; July–October for northern Serengeti Mara River crossings. See our dedicated migration guide for region-by-region detail.

faqs.q: When is Zanzibar best after a safari?
faqs.a: June–October and January–February are popular beach windows. Shoulder months can offer quieter hotels. We align island nights with your last safari day and flight connections from Arusha or Kilimanjaro.

faqs.q: When is the best time to climb Kilimanjaro?
faqs.a: Dry-leaning windows around January–March and June–October are commonly preferred. We schedule trek days around your safari so recovery and transfers stay realistic.
